classification_detail: Part (a) fully proven: weak convergence + norm convergence implies strong convergence, using norm_sub_sq_real identity and Real.sqrt continuity. Part (b) has 1 sorry: the weak lower semicontinuity of the norm is proven informally (for any a < ||h||, eventually a <= ||h_n|| via the norm identity and weak convergence), but the Lean proof is blocked on constructing IsCoboundedUnder for le_liminf_of_le and on the liminf_eq + le_csSup approach requiring BddAbove.
